The music staff is highlighted and displays the note name as you play.  Add note names to the keys if desired.

Select fast or slow tempo.  Use the Tempo Switch in the settings to select the speed and play along with full accompaniment.

Adjust song volume in Settings.  Want the background music to play more softly?  You may adjust the volume of the background music and the piano keys separately to get the balance just the way you like it.

Improved key responsiveness and song animation.  Includes five octaves of keys.  Scroll the keyboard left or right using the area just above the keys when a song is not playing.

Musical arrangements are based on traditional folk and classical melodies presented in variety of styles.

Piano... is ad-supported.  You may unlock all songs and remove advertisements using In-App Purchase.

Piano App Terms of Use: https://www.singtolearn.com/piano-app-terms-of-use.html


Thank you for playing!

What are you listening to?


HOW IT WORKS


1. At a random time each day, a notification will prompt you and your friends to share your most recently played song.


2. Show your friends what you really think about their music taste by swiping right to save the songs they share or left if they're not your style.


3. Don't limit yourself: update your friends on what you’re listening to and share messages throughout the day.


4. All of the songs your friends share with you show up in real time on a widget for your iPhone home screen.
